description: Make canonical dam state, carried weight, ladder descent, river entry, gear loss, and prepared rescue compose into deterministic survival outcomes.

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE DAM-ROOM-FCN (RARG)
   	 <COND (<EQUAL? .RARG ,M-LOOK>
		<TELL
"You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant. There are paths to
the north, south, and west, and a scramble down." CR>
		<COND (<AND ,LOW-TIDE ,GATES-OPEN>
		       <TELL
"The water level behind the dam is low: The sluice gates have been
opened. Water rushes through the dam and downstream." CR>)
		      (,GATES-OPEN
		       <TELL
"The sluice gates are open, and water rushes through the dam. The
water level behind the dam is still high." CR>)
		      (,LOW-TIDE
		       <TELL
"The sluice gates are closed. The water level in the reservoir is
quite low, but the level is rising quickly." CR>)
		      (T
		       <TELL
"The sluice gates on the dam are closed. Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide reservoir. Water is pouring over the top of the now
abandoned dam." CR>)>
		<TELL
"There is a control panel here, on which a large metal bolt is mounted.
Directly above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble">
		<COND (,GATE-FLAG
		       <TELL " which is
glowing serenely">)>
		<TELL "." CR>)>>

<ROUTINE DAM-ROOM-FCN (RARG)
   	 <COND (<EQUAL? .RARG ,M-LOOK>
		<TELL
"You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant. There are paths to
the north, south, and west, and a scramble down. An old iron maintenance
ladder drops down the downstream face beside the scramble." CR>
		<COND (<AND ,LOW-TIDE ,GATES-OPEN>
		       <TELL
"The water level behind the dam is low: The sluice gates have been
opened. Water rushes through the dam and downstream, throwing cold spray
across the lower ladder rungs." CR>)
		      (,GATES-OPEN
		       <TELL
"The sluice gates are open, and water rushes through the dam. The
water level behind the dam is still high. The maintenance ladder below
is wet with discharge spray." CR>)
		      (,LOW-TIDE
		       <TELL
"The sluice gates are closed. The water level in the reservoir is
quite low, but the level is rising quickly. The exposed ladder is damp
but no longer being hammered by discharge." CR>)
		      (T
		       <TELL
"The sluice gates on the dam are closed. Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide reservoir. Water is pouring over the top of the now
abandoned dam, wetting the lower maintenance ladder." CR>)>
		<TELL
"There is a control panel here, on which a large metal bolt is mounted.
Directly above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble">
		<COND (,GATE-FLAG
		       <TELL " which is
glowing serenely">)>
		<TELL "." CR>)>>

<ROUTINE DAM-BASE-FCN (RARG)
	<COND (<EQUAL? .RARG ,M-LOOK>
	       <TELL
"You are at the base of Flood Control Dam #3, which looms above you
and to the north. The river Frigid is flowing by here. An iron maintenance
ladder climbs the downstream face of the dam beside the ordinary scramble.
Along the river are the White Cliffs, giant walls stretching north to south
as the river winds downstream." CR>
	       <COND (,GATES-OPEN
	              <TELL "Water discharged through the open sluices tears past the landing with enough force to make entering it a survival decision." CR>)
	             (,LOW-TIDE
	              <TELL "With the gates closed and the reservoir low, the water at the landing is bitterly cold but comparatively quiet." CR>)
	             (T
	              <TELL "Overflow from the high reservoir keeps the river restless and the lower ladder slick." CR>)>)>>

<ROUTINE DAM-SURVIVAL-SEVERITY ()
	<COND (,GATES-OPEN <RETURN 2>)
	      (<NOT ,LOW-TIDE> <RETURN 1>)>
	<RETURN 0>>

<ROUTINE DAM-SURVIVAL-OVERBURDENED? ()
	<COND (<G? <* <WEIGHT ,WINNER> 2> ,LOAD-ALLOWED> <RTRUE>)>
	<RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE DAM-SURVIVAL-ROPE-PREPARED? ()
	<COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR ,DAM-MAINTENANCE-LADDER>
	            <SHADOW-HELD? ,ROPE>>
	       <RTRUE>)>
	<RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE DAM-SURVIVAL-DROP-HEAVIEST ("AUX" ITEM BEST (BEST-WEIGHT 0) WT)
	<SET ITEM <FIRST? ,WINNER>>
	<REPEAT ()
	        <COND (<NOT .ITEM> <RETURN>)>
	        <COND (<AND <FSET? .ITEM ,TAKEBIT>
	                    <NOT <FSET? .ITEM ,WEARBIT>>
	                    <NOT <FSET? .ITEM ,SACREDBIT>>
	                    <NOT <EQUAL? .ITEM ,ROPE ,INFLATED-BOAT>>>
	               <SET WT <WEIGHT .ITEM>>
	               <COND (<G? .WT .BEST-WEIGHT>
	                      <SET BEST .ITEM>
	                      <SET BEST-WEIGHT .WT>)>)>
	        <SET ITEM <NEXT? .ITEM>>>
	<COND (.BEST <MOVE .BEST ,DAM-BASE>)>
	<RETURN .BEST>>

<ROUTINE DAM-SURVIVAL-LADDER-MOVE ("AUX" SEVERITY LOST)
	<COND (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,DAM-BASE>
	       <TELL "You climb the iron maintenance ladder, keeping three points of contact on the old rungs until you reach the top of the dam." CR CR>
	       <GOTO ,DAM-ROOM>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<NOT <EQUAL? ,HERE ,DAM-ROOM>> <RFALSE>)
	      (<VERB? CLIMB-UP CLIMB-FOO>
	       <TELL "You are already at the top of the maintenance ladder. DOWN is the interesting direction." CR>
	       <RTRUE>)>
	<SET SEVERITY <DAM-SURVIVAL-SEVERITY>>
	<COND (<0? .SEVERITY>
	       <TELL "You descend the maintenance ladder. The old iron is damp and cold, but the low, gated-off flow leaves you time to place each foot deliberately." CR CR>
	       <GOTO ,DAM-BASE>)
	      (<DAM-SURVIVAL-ROPE-PREPARED?>
	       <TELL "You descend with the free rope in hand while its other end remains tied to the maintenance ladder. A wet rung steals one foot, but the anchored handline checks the slip before the dam can turn it into a fall." CR CR>
	       <GOTO ,DAM-BASE>)
	      (<AND <EQUAL? .SEVERITY 2> <DAM-SURVIVAL-OVERBURDENED?>>
	       <TELL "You start down carrying more than half the load you can safely manage. Discharge spray turns a rung slick beneath you. With no anchored handline and too much weight committed to the descent, your grip goes with your footing." CR>
	       <JIGS-UP "The river below completes the lesson in prepared rescue.">)
	      (<AND <EQUAL? .SEVERITY 1> <DAM-SURVIVAL-OVERBURDENED?>>
	       <SET LOST <DAM-SURVIVAL-DROP-HEAVIEST>>
	       <TELL "Overflow spray makes the lower ladder treacherous. Your burden swings, a boot skates off iron, and you save yourself only by sacrificing control of your load.">
	       <COND (.LOST
	              <TELL " The " D .LOST " tears free and clatters onto the landing below, where it can be recovered.">)
	             (T
	              <TELL " You slam hard into the rungs, but there is mercifully nothing loose enough to lose.">)>
	       <CRLF>
	       <CRLF>
	       <GOTO ,DAM-BASE>)
	      (T
	       <TELL "You descend slowly through the spray. The ladder is slick enough to demand respect, but your manageable load leaves a hand free whenever a rung tries something treacherous." CR CR>
	       <GOTO ,DAM-BASE>)>
	<RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE DAM-SURVIVAL-WATER-ENTRY ()
	<COND (<NOT <EQUAL? ,HERE ,DAM-BASE>> <RFALSE>)
	      (<EQUAL? <LOC ,WINNER> ,INFLATED-BOAT>
	       <TELL "You are already sitting in the seaworthy answer to this problem. LAUNCH the boat instead of volunteering to swim beside it." CR>
	       <RTRUE>)>
	<COND (<EQUAL? <DAM-SURVIVAL-SEVERITY> 2>
	       <COND (<DAM-SURVIVAL-ROPE-PREPARED?>
	              <TELL "Keeping the free end of the anchored rope in both hands, you step into the Frigid River. The sluice discharge instantly knocks your legs from under you, but the maintenance-ladder knot holds. Hand over hand, numb and chastened, you claw back onto the landing." CR>)
	             (T
	              <TELL "You enter the Frigid River below open sluice gates. The current removes your footing before cold can remove your enthusiasm, and there is no fixed line to arrest the downstream pull." CR>
	              <JIGS-UP "Prepared rescue would have made this an experiment instead of an ending.">)>)
	      (T
	       <TELL "You ease into the river beside the landing. The water is shockingly cold and strong enough to answer every heroic theory at once. You retreat to shore before the experiment becomes a downstream itinerary." CR>)>
	<RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE DAM-SURVIVAL-HOOK ()
	<COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,DAM-MAINTENANCE-LADDER>
	            <VERB? CLIMB-DOWN CLIMB-UP CLIMB-FOO>>
	       <DAM-SURVIVAL-LADDER-MOVE>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE ,DAM-BASE>
	            <OR <VERB? SWIM>
	                <AND <VERB? LEAP>
	                     <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,RIVER ,GLOBAL-WATER ,WATER>>>>
	       <DAM-SURVIVAL-WATER-ENTRY>
	       <RTRUE>)>
	<RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE DAM-MAINTENANCE-LADDER-F ()
	<COND (<VERB? EXAMINE>
	       <TELL "The iron maintenance ladder is bolted directly into the downstream face of Flood Control Dam #3. ">
	       <COND (,GATES-OPEN
	              <TELL "Sluice discharge throws spray across the lower rungs. A heavy descent without a fixed handline would be reckless.">)
	             (<NOT ,LOW-TIDE>
	              <TELL "Overflow keeps the lower rungs wet. A heavy load could turn one slip into lost gear.">)
	             (T
	              <TELL "With the reservoir low and the gates closed, the rungs are merely old, cold, and damp.">)>
	       <COND (<DAM-SURVIVAL-ROPE-PREPARED?>
	              <TELL " One end of your rope is tied securely to the ladder, leaving the coil as a prepared handline.">)>
	       <CRLF>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<VERB? TAKE MOVE>
	       <TELL "The ladder is bolted into the dam with considerably more conviction than you can carry." CR>
	       <RTRUE>)>
	<RFALSE>>
